Omega-3 fatty acids are widely studied for their health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving heart health. Research has consistently linked omega-3 intake to a lower incidence of cardiovascular disease, such as through reduced triglycerides, blood pressure, and plaque buildup in arteries. While omega-3 may have some benefits for other conditions, the strongest evidence supports its role in cardiovascular disease prevention.
